chunks.text: We provide expert grooming services in a friendly, calm and caring environment for small sized dogs. We only use the best top quality products, selected for your dog based on their coat and skin condition.

All dogs are individuals and require their own tailored grooming process for their unique needs. WHO'S A GOOD DOG? will discuss best options on initial consultation. You can be assured that we treat every dog we groom as one of our own, with compassion, respect and love.

At WHO'S A GOOD DOG? we offer a range of services. We will assess your dog’s coat and discuss what style will best suit them based on your dog’s general coat condition, lifestyle, breed/crossbreed, temperament and owners commitment to at-home maintenance between grooming appointments. Recommendations will then be given about the frequency of grooming appointments based on the above criteria.

Full Groom (Trimmed Breeds) The full groom experience at WHO'S A GOOD DOG? for trimmed breeds includes: • Full de-tangling • Shampoo & conditioning • Coat carefully dried • Ear care • External anal gland expression • Nail clipping • Sanitary clip • Parasite check • Styled to breed standard or agreed alternative style All shampoos/conditioners are of the highest quality and designed for dogs. Selected shampoo is based on your dog's coat type and skin condition. Each dog is an individual. Please call for initial consultation and starting price for your dog. Prices are inclusive of VAT @23%

WHO'S A GOOD DOG? was established in 2022 and is owned and managed by Master Dog Groomer Tom O’Mahony. Tom Graduated from Sparsholt College in 2006 with a BTEC National Diploma in Animal Management, he then began his dog grooming career in 2007 in a prestigious dog grooming salon in Dublin, where he remained until 2022 holding the position of Head Stylist.

In 2014 Tom became fully qualified with a City & Guilds Diploma for Professional Dog Stylists. In 2018 he gained his Master Craftsman (MCG) dog grooming qualification, and furthermore in 2025 he gained his International Certified Master Groomer (ICMG) qualification, making him Irelands first double Master qualified dog groomer.

Over the years Tom has successfully competed in dog grooming competitions at a very high standard and regularly wins or is placed in various classes. He is an internationally award winning dog groomer with career highlights being awarded Reserve Dog Groomer of the Year in both 2016 and 2022 in the annual IPDGA (Irish Professional Dog Groomers Association) competition.

Tom keeps up to date with the latest grooming styles and salon practices by regularly attending educational seminars in order to ensure that the services offered by WHO'S A GOOD DOG? are the best and most up-to-date available. He also employs the safest salons practices by being a trained Canine First Aid Responder. Tom is also an active member of the IPDGA.

Jonny is responsible for the day-to-day financial management of the business as well as coordinating promotion of the WHO’S A GOOD DOG? brand through the various social media marketing channels. Jonny holds an Honours Degree in Business Studies (Entrepreneurship) from IADT and has worked successfully in the financial services industry since 2005.
